worldgen.action.randomizeSeed.label: Randomize seed
worldgen.action.randomizeSeed.help: Roll a new random seed for the world.
worldgen.action.resetArchean.label: Restart the Archean
worldgen.action.resetArchean.help: Discard the young world and start the Archean over.
worldgen.panel.genesis.mantleVigour.help: How vigorously the mantle churns — more vigour breaks up crust faster.
worldgen.panel.genesis.water.label: Water
worldgen.panel.genesis.water.help: How much water the young world has — offsets where crust can nucleate.
worldgen.action.runArchean.label: Run the Archean
worldgen.action.runArchean.help: Grow the first crust until proto-cratons stabilise.
worldgen.panel.genesis.stage.early: New crust is still forming and dissolving — keep running.
worldgen.panel.genesis.stage.window: Still drifting — stop now for an archipelago world.
worldgen.panel.genesis.stage.late: Continents are merging into a supercontinent.
worldgen.action.resetSim.label: Reset simulation
worldgen.action.resetSim.help: Reset the tectonic simulation to its starting state.
worldgen.action.runTectonics.label: Run tectonics
worldgen.action.runTectonics.help: Drift the plates — continents collide, rift, and cycle.
worldgen.action.resetErosion.label: Revert to tectonics result
worldgen.action.resetErosion.help: Undo erosion and return to the raw tectonic terrain.
worldgen.panel.erosion.age.label: Landscape age
worldgen.panel.erosion.age.help: How long erosion works the terrain — young keeps the raw tectonic relief and cuts sharp valleys, old wears everything toward smooth plains.
worldgen.panel.erosion.alluvium.label: Floodplains
worldgen.panel.erosion.alluvium.help: How readily rivers drop their load — more builds broad valley floors and big deltas, less exports the sediment to the sea.
worldgen.panel.erosion.rockContrast.help: How differently hard and soft rock erode — more carves deep basins between standing ridges, none erodes evenly.
worldgen.action.runErosion.label: Run erosion
worldgen.action.runErosion.help: Weather the terrain — cut valleys and fill basins.
worldgen.action.runDetailBake.label: Bake the selected resolutions
worldgen.action.runDetailBake.help: Runs this world's erosion at each selected resolution, one after the other, and stores the results. The 2K world stays the authority — a bake refines it and never feeds back. Needs at least one erosion pass first.
worldgen.action.resetClimate.label: Reset climate to defaults
worldgen.action.resetClimate.help: Return every climate lever to its default.
worldgen.panel.climate.temperature.label: Temperature
worldgen.panel.climate.temperature.help: Warm or cool the whole world.
worldgen.panel.climate.equator.label: Equator
worldgen.panel.climate.equator.help: Shift the warm belt north or south of the map's middle.
worldgen.panel.climate.humidity.label: Humidity
worldgen.panel.climate.humidity.help: Scale global rainfall up or down.
worldgen.panel.climate.contrast.label: Contrast
worldgen.panel.climate.contrast.help: How sharply temperature falls from equator to poles.
worldgen.panel.hydrology.riverDensity.he: How many rivers are drawn — from only the largest to a fine network.
worldgen.action.resetEcology.label: Reset ecology to defaults
worldgen.action.resetEcology.help: Return every ecology lever to its default.
Scale how many people the land can support overall.
worldgen.panel.ecology.concentration.hel: Spread resources evenly or clump them into rich pockets.
worldgen.panel.ecology.provinces.label: Provinces
worldgen.panel.ecology.provinces.help: How strongly resources cluster into regional provinces.
worldgen.ecology.cat.subsistence.label: Subsistence
worldgen.ecology.cat.subsistence.help: Food resources: arable land, fish, game, pasture.
worldgen.ecology.cat.material.label: Material
worldgen.ecology.cat.metal.label: Metals
worldgen.ecology.cat.prestige.label: Prestige
worldgen.action.resetMigration.label: Reset migration to defaults
worldgen.action.resetMigration.help: Return every migration lever to its default.
worldgen.panel.migration.spread.label: Spread
worldgen.panel.migration.spread.help: How far each people disperses from its origin.
worldgen.panel.migration.arrows.label: Arrows
worldgen.panel.migration.arrows.help: Prune faint migration arrows below this threshold.
worldgen.panel.migration.seaCrossing.hel: How readily peoples cross shallow seas and land bridges.
worldgen.notify.needsTectonics: First run tectonics to at least epoch {min} (now {current}).
worldgen.notify.needsErosion: First run erosion at least once — climate, rivers, ecology and migration need the eroded terrain.
worldgen.panel.erosion.bake4k.label: 4K
worldgen.panel.erosion.bake4k.help: 4096×2048 — finer valleys and a denser river network. Bakes on the server when this world is stored there, otherwise in this browser.
worldgen.panel.erosion.bake8k.label: 8K
worldgen.panel.erosion.bake8k.help: 8192×4096. Too large for a browser to compute, so it needs a server — and this world must be saved there first.
worldgen.panel.erosion.bake16k.label: 16K
worldgen.panel.erosion.bake16k.help: 16384×8192 — not available yet. Even the finished terrain is ~270 MB per layer, more than a map view can load in one piece, so this tier waits on tiled artifacts.
worldgen.panel.erosion.bake.needsServer: Needs a server that can bake.
worldgen.panel.erosion.bake.needsSignIn: 8K needs the server — sign in first.
